vfx_fly_wind.png.prompt:
The attached reference image is an existing icon from this game - match its line weight and its clean cartoon look, but this new picture must be much LIGHTER and more minimal than the reference.

Draw a WHIRLWIND MADE ONLY OF LINES - not a solid object.
Think of the little spiral of wind drawn under a hovering character in a comic: just two or three thin curved strokes that spiral outward and upward, wide at the top and narrowing to a point at the bottom, with a small gap between each stroke so you can see straight through it. Add two or three tiny comma-shaped flicks around it to suggest swirling air.

CRITICAL:
- NO filled body, NO solid mass, NO shading, NO gradient. It is a LINE DRAWING of moving air.
- The strokes should be soft pale blue-white with a thin darker outline, and clearly SEPARATE from each other - mostly empty space between them.
- Do NOT draw a thick chunky cone or a heavy funnel. The previous attempt was far too solid and heavy.

This sits UNDER a flying monster to show it is hovering, so: it must read at about 100 pixels wide, the shape must be centred horizontally, and the picture must be WIDER THAN TALL (a low, flat swirl).
Nothing else in the picture: no ground, no shadow, no creature, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers, no watermark.
The strokes themselves must be SOLID and OPAQUE where they are drawn (no semi-transparent paint - that turns into green fringes when the background is keyed out); theempty space between them stays background.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green in the strokes.
Output 512x384 PNG. Save the image as vfx_fly_wind.png in the current directory and report the path.
